title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
title_zh: 重放而非重采样：长时程强化学习专家的离策略整合
abstract_en: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.
abstract_zh: 主流后训练流程先用强化学习（RL）为每个领域训练一个专家，再通过多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）将专家整合到单一学生模型中。MOPD 需要学生在各环境中重新采样、由专家逐 token 评分，还会让学生继承最终专家的策略漂移。本文提出多专家重放策略蒸馏（MRPD）：按各专家原本的学习顺序重放训练日志，利用记录了采样概率和奖励的轨迹重新计算策略梯度，并在日志记录的前缀上蒸馏最终专家的输出分布。沿原训练顺序重放可缩小训练与推理之间的分布差异，使学生策略保持在裁剪范围内，让源自离策略数据的整合过程近似同策略训练。MRPD 无需重新采样，也不调用环境或奖励模型，整合算力约为训练这些专家所用算力的七分之一。在推理、搜索和 SQL 三类长时程智能体任务中，MRPD 显著优于在线 RL 基线，并以远低于 MOPD 的成本取得更好的学生模型。消融分析表明，重放轨迹贡献了大部分收益，策略梯度和蒸馏项均带来额外提升；日志顺序比数据量或奖励更重要，说明专家训练日志更像一套课程，而不是无序的数据混合。
key_points_zh: MRPD 复用带采样概率和奖励的专家训练轨迹，同时重算策略梯度并蒸馏最终专家的输出分布。
按原始训练顺序重放，使学生策略保持在裁剪范围内，让离策略数据支持近似同策略的更新。
整合不需要重新采样或调用环境与奖励模型，算力约为训练这些专家所需算力的七分之一。
在推理、搜索和 SQL 上，MRPD 优于在线 RL 基线，也以更低成本超越使用相同专家的 MOPD。
重放轨迹贡献主要收益，策略梯度和蒸馏项均有额外贡献；日志顺序比数据量或奖励更重要。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是按专家原训练顺序回放带奖励的智能体轨迹，在不重新采样的情况下用策略梯度和蒸馏更新学生策略。推理、搜索和 SQL 上的同源专家对比报告了性能优势，并给出了相对专家训练的计算成本；但摘录未提供逐域效应量或消融细节。保留日志顺序是可操作的设计选择。
